description: This is a Java test class for the UpdateFileParser, containing unit tests to verify its parsing functionality for different XML update configurations.

classes.name: UpdateFileParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the UpdateFileParser's ability to parse update XML files and set properties correctly.

methods.name: parse_shouldsetPropertiesFromXmlFile
methods.description: Test that verifies UpdateFileParser correctly parses XML and sets moduleId, currentVersion, and downloadURL.

methods.name: parse_shouldSetPropertiesUsingNewestUpdate
methods.description: Test that verifies parser selects the newest update from multiple XML update entries.

methods.name: parse_shouldNotSetPropertiesUsingUpdatesAheadOfCurrentOpenmrsVersion
methods.description: Test that verifies parser ignores updates requiring a higher OpenMRS version than current.
